goal: 连续完成可闭合山门、实体念珠和实体木鱼，并直接接入本地场景

tasks.name: 山门单扇木门
tasks.runtime_behavior: clone and mirror into two pivoted leaves; close in gate view and open when entering
tasks.review: solid timber planks, rails, bronze studs and hinge straps; mirrored pair closes the gate opening without gaps

tasks.name: 实体念珠
tasks.runtime_behavior: hang on a physical hall stand; bottom action opens the actual GLB in an interactive viewer and every bead turn rotates both preview and hall model
tasks.review: individual sandalwood beads, mother bead, continuous cord and tassel are readable

tasks.name: 实体木鱼
tasks.runtime_behavior: place in the hall; bottom action opens the actual GLB in an interactive viewer and animates the split native mallet in sync with sound
tasks.review: hollow carved fish body, sounding slit, lacquered wood, compressed brocade cushion and separate native mallet

acceptance: door leaf reads as solid movable timber construction and forms a clean mirrored pair
prayer beads read as individual wooden beads on a continuous physical cord
wooden fish reads as a hollow carved instrument rather than a toy or icon
all three assets use consistent restrained temple PBR materials
gate opening, bead turn and wooden-fish strike remain functional
